name: Murai Rinko
source:
The protagonist's mother. She is an ex-yankee with a strong sense of humor. She likes men who are more like her than her own husband. She educates her son to be the same way.

She is 39 years old and still working. She is a career woman who is also Maiko's manager as a TV personality.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=753070]getchu[/url]]
